scientific_question: In wild Ya Ha Tinda GPS-collared female elk, is the Love-Otto IID CV-ratio robust to which ten simultaneously observed females are sampled, across all 8 officially movement-eligible autumn seasons?
scientific_scope: Conditional sampling variability among observed collars; no demographic outcome, no future-warning validation, no inference about geometry of uncollared herd members.
prior_exposure: 2004 teaching mirror subset already yielded 43 days and substantial 10-of-11/12 subsample spread
official Movebank aggregate coverage gate identified eight eligible years
the predeclared future-demography test stopped at six years of coverage-to-outcome overlap
the related Mac Hugh wild recruitment longitudinal-variance forecast returned a heldout null; it does not test Love-Otto IID CV

source.source_access: official anonymous Movebank DSpace REST in disposable GitHub Actions runner

fixed_sampling.timestamp: Source canonical UTC; timezone-naive canonical Movebank timestamps interpreted as UTC only under source-specific prior amendment
fixed_sampling.event_qc: exclude visible=false and non-GPS sensor rows when fields present
fixed_sampling.snapshot: one per individual-day, nearest local 12:00, max 6.5 hours; ties choose earlier UTC timestamp; no interpolation
fixed_sampling.deterministic_order: sort unique individual IDs by (sha256(`${date}|${replicate}|${individual_id}`), individual_id), take first 10
fixed_sampling.when_exactly_n: one distinct subset; report zero conditional subsample spread, not 100 independent draws
fixed_sampling.projection: EPSG:26911 NAD83/GRS80 UTM11N formula matching already-audited mirror diagnostic
fixed_sampling.metric: Love-Otto CV_ind/CV_pop, sample-SD, Euclidean projected IID, log10=FALSE
fixed_sampling.all_collared_reference: compute same metric from all contemporaneous GPS-collared females (not ground truth for entire herd)

stop_rules: Do not inspect or join recruitment, survival or abundance outcome rows.
Do not relax biological daily/annual gates or move the season to increase sample size.
Do not change primary metric from CV_ind/CV_pop after seeing measurement variation.
Do not call all-collared reference the complete herd.
Do not label within-day subsample quantiles predictive confidence intervals.
Abort if source-file SHA does not match the pinned official deposit.
Abort if annual eligibility differs from the official coverage result; investigate rather than silently reclassify.
No animal-day coordinates, individual IDs or event CSV uploaded or committed.
Do not classify indicator fluctuations as ecological fragmentation, collapse, or false alarms without independently measured states/outcomes.
